arguments.content:
import zipfile
from xml.dom import minidom

with zipfile.ZipFile('quarterly_report.docx') as z:
    names = z.namelist()
    xml = z.read('word/document.xml')

doc = minidom.parseString(xml)

def para_text(p):
    return ''.join(t.firstChild.nodeValue for r in p.getElementsByTagName('w:r')
                   for t in r.getElementsByTagName('w:t') if t.firstChild)

headlines = []
total_u = 0
for p in doc.getElementsByTagName('w:p'):
    text = para_text(p)
    if text and any(c.isalpha() for c in text) and text == text.upper():
        ucount = sum(len(r.getElementsByTagName('w:u')) for r in p.getElementsByTagName('w:r'))
        total_u += ucount
        headlines.append((text, ucount))

print('docx entries:', len(names))
print('document.xml present:', 'word/document.xml' in names)
print('headlines:', len(headlines))
for t, n in headlines:
    print(f'  {t}: {n} underlined run(s)')
print('total w:u elements:', total_u)
assert len(headlines) == 7
assert total_u == 7
print('OK')
